iroh.options.lod.enabled.tooltip: Draws the world far beyond the render distance from a stored low-detail copy. Off frees all of its GPU memory and stops its threads, no restart needed.
iroh.options.lod.distance.tooltip: How far distant terrain reaches, in blocks. Farther costs more video memory and background work.
iroh.options.lod.detailDistance.tooltip: Radius of the full-detail level. Every doubling past it halves the detail (levels 1 to 4).
iroh.options.lod.blendWidth.tooltip: Width of the dithered band that mixes two detail levels. 0 switches cleanly.
iroh.options.lod.transitionMs.tooltip: How long a loaded chunk fades in over the distant terrain it replaces.
iroh.options.lod.landmarks.tooltip: Keeps landmarks (places mods or the config list register) at a higher detail level from far away.
iroh.options.lod.brightness.tooltip: Brightness of distant terrain. Used when no shader pack is active.
iroh.options.lod.saturation.tooltip: Colour saturation of distant terrain. Used when no shader pack is active.
iroh.options.lod.fogDistance.tooltip: Where distance fog ends, as a share of the Distant Terrain distance. Used when no shader pack is active.
iroh.options.lod.nightLights.tooltip: Lit blocks (lamps, torches, lava) keep glowing on distant terrain at night.
iroh.options.lod.motion.tooltip: Leaves sway and water ripples on distant terrain.
iroh.options.lod.weatherOnLods.tooltip: Storms, snow, wet ground, dust, gloom and lightning also show on distant terrain. Needs Tempest; used when no shader pack is active.
iroh.options.lod.weatherCurtains.tooltip: Rain, snow, sand and lava curtains over far storms. Needs Tempest; used when no shader pack is active.
iroh.options.lod.farPlayers.tooltip: Players beyond entity range appear as figures on distant terrain.
iroh.options.lod.farPlayerMinPixels.tool: Smallest height of a far player figure on screen. 0 draws it at true size.
iroh.options.lod.nameTagDistance.tooltip: How far name tags show over far player figures. 0 hides them.
iroh.options.lod.seedLods.tooltip: Generates far terrain from the world generator before you have visited it.
iroh.options.lod.captureVisited.tooltip: On servers without Iroh Distant Terrain, keeps a local copy of the chunks you have seen so they show far away later.
iroh.options.lod.shareWithMaps.tooltip: Lets map mods that have a bridge read distant terrain through Iroh's public Distant Terrain API.
iroh.options.lod.budgetMiB.tooltip: Cap on video memory for distant terrain, inside Iroh's own share. Auto picks it from the free memory when you join.
iroh.options.lod.occlusionCulling.toolti: Skips distant terrain hidden behind nearer terrain (depth pyramid test).
iroh.options.lod.workerThreads.tooltip: Threads for capturing, building levels and seed generation. Auto chooses from your CPU.
iroh.options.lod.uploadMiBPerFrame.toolt: Most data sent to the GPU per frame for distant terrain. Lower is smoother, higher fills in faster.
iroh.options.lod.debugLevels.tooltip: Tints each detail level a different colour. For debugging.
iroh.options.lod.debugFreeze.tooltip: Stops distant terrain from loading or unloading. For debugging pop-in.
iroh.options.lod.server.structurePass.to: This world (hosting): generates surface structures ahead of players so distant terrain shows them.
iroh.options.lod.server.structureRange.t: This world (hosting): how far ahead structures are generated, in blocks.
iroh.options.lod.server.shareSeedTerrain: This world (hosting): sends clients what they need to generate seed terrain (never the world seed).
iroh.options.lod.server.sharePlayerPosit: This world (hosting): tells clients where far players are so they can draw them.
iroh.lod.status.tooltip: Whether Distant Terrain is running, and if not, why.
iroh.lod.native.tooltip: The Rust library that stores and reads distant terrain data. A Java fallback is used when it is missing.
iroh.lod.reason.vista: The Vista mod is installed, Distant Terrain is off
iroh.lod.reason.noBridge: No map mod bridge is installed
